assessment.summary: BOOM Live's fact-check directly refutes the claim, finding no comment by Kunal Kamra on the Pulwama attack in his stand-up shows or otherwise, and identifying the quote as a fake attributed to him on Twitter.

evidence.finding: BOOM Live states it could not find any comment by Kamra on the attack in any of his stand-up comedy shows or otherwise, and lists the exact claim as a fake quote attributed to him.

The fact-check reproduces the exact Hindi text of the viral quote and attributes its circulation to Twitter, confirming the quote's provenance as a social-media claim rather than a verified Kamra statement.
The Hindu reports the SUV driven by the suicide bomber was packed with RDX, corroborating the factual premise about the explosive but not attributing any statement to Kamra.

assertions.assertion: Kunal Kamra said, The RDX laden car which caused the blast in Pulwama, RTO has not been able to access its papers stating under whose name it was registered, till date. The government wants more than 70 year old papers in the NRC.

gaps: No primary record (video, transcript, or Kamra's own statement) was retrieved to independently confirm or deny the quote beyond the single fact-check; the fact-check is the sole decisive source.
